examples.en: It (still) isn’t clear to me what this means.
examples.ko: 이것이 무슨 뜻인지 나는 아직도 잘 모르겠다.

examples.en: Don't be so mean to your little sister.
examples.ko: 네 여동생에게 그렇게 못되게 굴지 마.

examples.en: I was cooking dinner; meanwhile, my brother set the table.
examples.ko: 나는 저녁을 요리하고 있었고, 그 동안 내 동생은 식탁을 차렸다.

examples.en: The bus was late. Meanwhile, we waited at the station.
examples.ko: 버스가 늦었다. 그 동안 우리는 역에서 기다렸다.

examples.en: Can you measure the length of this table?
examples.ko: 이 탁자의 길이를 재 줄 수 있니?

examples.en: The government took new measures to fight pollution.
examples.ko: 정부는 오염과 싸우기 위해 새로운 조치를 취했다.

examples.en: I don't eat meat.
This meat smells fresh.
The mechanic fixed my car engine quickly.
examples.ko: 정비공이 내 자동차 엔진을 빠르게 고쳤다.

examples.en: My uncle works as a mechanic at a garage.
The clock has a complex mechanism inside.
examples.ko: 그 시계는 내부에 복잡한 장치가 있다.

examples.en: Scientists studied the mechanism behind memory loss.
She won a gold medal.
He got a medal for running.
The teacher tried to mediate the argument between the students.
examples.ko: 선생님은 학생들 사이의 다툼을 중재하려고 했다.

examples.en: A neutral person can mediate a dispute fairly.
examples.ko: 중립적인 사람이 분쟁을 공정하게 중재할 수 있다.

examples.en: She needs medical help right away.
He works in the medical field as a nurse.
Take this medicine after meals.
She studies medicine at university.
The castle was built in medieval times.
We visited a medieval town in Europe last summer.
examples.ko: 우리는 지난여름 유럽의 중세 도시를 방문했다.

examples.en: I'd like a medium coffee, please.
Television is a powerful medium for advertising.
(I’m) (very) pleased to meet you.
Let's meet at the park.
This melon is very sweet.
We shared a melon after lunch.
examples.ko: 우리는 점심 후에 멜론을 나눠 먹었다.

examples.en: The ice began to melt in the sun.
She melted the chocolate for the cake.
I am a club member.
Every member has a name tag.
I have a good memory.
This is a happy memory.
Exercise is good for your mental health.
He solved the mental math problem quickly.
Don’t mention it.
She mentioned your name during the meeting.
examples.ko: 그녀는 회의 중에 네 이름을 언급했다.

examples.en: Can I see the menu, please?
The restaurant has a new menu this month.
examples.ko: 그 식당은 이번 달에 새 메뉴가 있다.

examples.en: The merchant sold spices in the market.
A wealthy merchant built this old house.
examples.ko: 부유한 상인이 이 오래된 집을 지었다.

examples.en: It was a mere coincidence, nothing more.
A mere apology cannot fix the damage done.
examples.ko: 단순한 사과로는 이미 생긴 피해를 고칠 수 없다.

examples.en: The two companies decided to merge next year.
examples.ko: 그 두 회사는 내년에 합병하기로 결정했다.

examples.en: The two rivers merge near the old bridge.
examples.ko: 그 두 강은 오래된 다리 근처에서 합쳐진다.

examples.en: This plan has several merits worth considering.
examples.ko: 이 계획은 고려할 만한 여러 장점이 있다.

examples.en: Her idea has real merit and deserves support.
examples.ko: 그녀의 생각은 진짜 가치가 있고 지지받을 만하다.

examples.en: Clean up this mess before dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹기 전에 이 엉망진창을 치워라.

examples.en: The kitchen was a mess after the party.
I sent her a message this morning.
examples.ko: 나는 오늘 아침 그녀에게 메시지를 보냈다.

examples.en: Did you get my message about the meeting?
This ring is made of metal.
The bridge is built from strong metal.
This is a good method for learning English.
They found a new method to save energy.
examples.ko: 그들은 에너지를 절약하는 새로운 방법을 찾았다.

examples.en: Seoul is a busy metropolitan city.
The metropolitan area has heavy traffic every morning.
examples.ko: 그 대도시 지역은 매일 아침 교통이 혼잡하다.

examples.en: Speak clearly into the microphone.
The singer dropped the microphone on stage.
Put the pizza in the microwave.
She microwaved the soup for two minutes.
Sit in the middle seat.
The book is in the middle.
It might rain today.
She might come to the party.
Birds migrate south every winter.
Many families migrated to the city for jobs.
examples.ko: 많은 가족들이 일자리를 찾아 도시로 이주했다.

examples.en: The weather today is mild and pleasant.
He has a mild case of the flu.
His father serves in the military.
The country increased its military spending this year.
examples.ko: 그 나라는 올해 군사 지출을 늘렸다.

examples.en: I drink milk every morning.
This milk is very cold.
The old mill still grinds wheat today.
examples.ko: 그 오래된 방앗간은 오늘날에도 밀을 빻는다.

examples.en: My grandfather worked at a paper mill.
The company earned a million dollars last year.
examples.ko: 그 회사는 작년에 백만 달러를 벌었다.

examples.en: Millions of people live in this crowded city.
examples.ko: 수백만 명의 사람들이 이 붐비는 도시에 산다.

examples.en: Would you mind closing the window?
Keep your mind open.
That red bike is mine.
Workers dug deep into the coal mine.
This water contains many useful minerals.
examples.ko: 이 물에는 유용한 무기질이 많이 들어 있다.

examples.en: Scientists found a rare mineral in the cave.
The damage from the storm was minimal.
We spent a minimal amount of money on the trip.
examples.ko: 우리는 그 여행에 최소한의 돈만 썼다.

examples.en: The minimum age to drive is eighteen.
Please keep noise to a minimum in the library.
The Ministry of Education announced new rules.
She works for the Ministry of Health.
It was only a minor mistake.
Alcohol cannot be sold to a minor.
Excuse me, can I talk to you for a minute?
examples.ko: 실례지만, 잠깐 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?

examples.en: Wait a minute, please.
It was a miracle that no one got hurt.
Doctors called her recovery a true miracle.
examples.ko: 의사들은 그녀의 회복을 진정한 기적이라고 불렀다.

examples.en: She looked at herself in the mirror.
The mirror on the wall is broken.
I miss my grandmother.
Don't miss the bus.
